notes:
Summary: Ironclad Inference Works is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for EU production workloads. Primary drivers: strict data residency (EU/DE preferred), comprehensive vendor risk evidence (SIG/CAIQ full), and HSM-backed key management. They run customer support chat + document search across regulated manufacturing customers.

Key requirements / asks: 
- Private VPC with traffic constrained to EU regions; no tokenized PII leaving region.
- KMS integration: must support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) with HSM or dedicated cloud KMS; explicit KMS rotation policy and key escrow options.
- Audit logging: immutable request/response audit trail, tamper-evident logs, retention policy configurable to 7 years, export to their SIEM (Splunk).
- Vendor risk intake: their infosec requires completed CAIQ (full) + Ridge (SIG) mapping; want control evidence (SOC2 report, ISO27001 scope, pen test summary).
- Shared responsibility: needs explicit diagram and matrix showing which controls are Redwood-managed vs customer-managed (network, secrets, application layer).
- Network: VPC peering + strict security groups; require maintenance window for peering (only Q2 calendar).
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms for short-chat flows, throughput 500 req/s for embeddings batch jobs. Cost sensitivity: mid-high (willing to pay for SLA + HSM).

Call quotes / call notes: 
- "We cannot accept vendor keys stored without HSM-backed controls" - Security lead (M. Vogel).
- "Need CAIQ fully completed before procurement packet can be elevated to legal" - Procurement.

Documents exchanged: CAIQ template shared via drive link; Redwood asked for a list of required evidence and sources (SOC2 report, ISO certs, pen test). Redwood to provide shared responsibility matrix and network architecture diagram for private deployment.

Action items assigned: 
- Redwood (Priya) to assemble CAIQ answers + attach evidence (SOC2 attestation) by 2026-03-18.
- Redwood (Jordan) to coordinate pricing addendum for HSM + 24x7 SLA.
- Ironclad to confirm KMS vendor preference (Azure Key Vault vs AWS KMS) and any legal language for key escrow.

Risks: 
- If Redwood cannot support customer-managed HSM keys, procurement will default to incumbent vendor.
- Peering windows may delay rollout into production H2.

Notes style: shorthand, bulleted items, paraphrased quotes. See linked Drive docs for CAIQ draft and vendor intake form.
